t: How Knot To Hang A Painting

q.x: I know the linked site in the submission is more about practical knots, everyday knots, but this Tom Scott guest video from Up and Atom on mathematical knots blew my mind. [link] So awesome that it's able to mathematically quantify knots.

desc:
Subscribe to Up and Atom! https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCSIvk78tK2TiviLQn4fSHaw/ or start with Jade's video on quantum tunnelling: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WPZLRtyvEqo

You've got a painting and two nails. Can you use both nails to hang the painting so that if either nail is removed, the painting falls? That's the puzzle: in this week's guest video, Jade's going to solve it with maths.

recs.stt: The Knot Book: Introduction to the Mathematical Theory of Knots (1994) [pdf]
recs.x:
This is a really nice introductory video (imo) on the topic by Up and Atom as a guest on Tom Scott's channel.
